name: Prevent Wall Deletion
description: Blocks all wall deletions to prevent accidental removal of critical elements
message:
Wall deletion is not permitted. Walls are critical structural elements.

If you need to delete this wall, please contact your BIM Manager.

name: Guide Structural Element Modifications
description: Show warning when modifying structural framing elements
message:
⚠️ Warning: You are about to modify a structural element.

Structural changes must be coordinated with the structural engineer.

Proceed with caution.

name: Guide Door Operations
description: Track all door modifications for audit purposes

name: Prevent Level Deletion
description: Blocks deletion of all level datums
message:
Level deletion is strictly prohibited.

Levels are critical project datums and cannot be removed.

Contact your BIM Coordinator if levels need to be adjusted.

name: Guide View Deletions
message:
⚠️ You are about to delete a view.

View deletion cannot be undone.

Are you sure you want to proceed?

name: Protect Pinned Elements
message:
🔒 This element is pinned and cannot be modified.

To modify this element:
1. Unpin the element first
2. Make your changes
3. Re-pin when complete

Contact your BIM Manager if you need assistance.

name: Prevent External Wall Modifications
message:
External walls cannot be modified without approval.

These walls define the building envelope and affect:
• Energy calculations
• Exterior finishes
• Cost estimates

Please contact the design lead before proceeding.

name: Prevent Grid Deletion
message:
Grid deletion is not permitted.

Grids are reference datums used throughout the project.

Deleting grids may break:
• Dimension references
• Alignment constraints
• Documentation

Contact your BIM Coordinator for assistance.

name: Guide Room Modifications
message:
⚠️ Room Modification Warning

Modifying rooms affects:
• Area calculations
• Room schedules
• Space planning documentation

Ensure changes are coordinated with the team.
